question: In frequentist hypothesis testing, which statement correctly defines the reported p-value?
options: The probability that the null hypothesis is true
The size of the treatment effect
The chance that data were fabricated
The probability, under the null model, of a result at least as extreme as the observed one
explanation: A p-value conditions on the null and does not assign probability to the hypothesis itself.
subject: Applied Statistical Analysis

provenance.answerEvidence: A p-value conditions on the null and does not assign probability to the hypothesis itself. Authoritative verification: https://www.itl.nist.gov/div898/handbook/
